'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Stephan de Vos LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephan de Vos]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
